data.name: Fractal Descent
data.detailed_description:
Fractal Descent is a 2D sci-fi mining and combat roguelite about dropping onto hostile planets, digging through destructible worlds, and fighting your way back out with everything you can carry.

From your persistent spaceship hub, choose a mission, prepare your weapons, drones, relics, and equipment, then launch into a procedurally generated planet with its own biome, ores, hazards, enemies, structures, and difficulty. Each world is a self-contained expedition, ranging from short raids to long descents and endless post-game runs.

Mine valuable resources, uncover abandoned industrial facilities, and push deeper into increasingly dangerous territory. Ore must be processed and extracted before it becomes safe, turning every successful haul into a high-stakes operation. Defend extraction drones, secure portal stations, and decide when to keep pushing or escape before the planet overwhelms you.

Combat is built around varied weapons, drones, relics, and modular weapon modifiers that create unpredictable builds as the run develops. Projectiles can split, pierce, home, explode, ricochet, or interact with the environment in increasingly destructive combinations.

The planets themselves are active threats. Lava, gas, unstable machinery, toxic growths, and fractal breaches reshape routes and turn ordinary encounters into emergent disasters. Dig new tunnels, redirect hazards, exploit the terrain, and survive the chaos.

Extract resources, unlock new equipment, upgrade your ship, and chart a path through increasingly unstable regions toward the Universe Core.

data.short_description: Drop from your spaceship into hostile procedural planets. Mine valuable ore, battle enemies, redirect deadly hazards, build destructive weapon combinations, and extract your haul before the depths overwhelm you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560 / Intel Arc or equivalent with Vulkan/DirectX 12 support
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Integrated GPUs may work but are not currently targeted for minimum support. Requirements may change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 / Intel Arc A750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Recommended specs target smoother performance with advanced lighting, dense caves, particle effects, and larger enemy encounters.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3.0 or compatible 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560 / Intel Arc or equivalent with Vulkan support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio/PipeWire-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan-capable GPU and up-to-date graphics drivers required. Steam Deck support is not guaranteed yet.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3.0 or compatible 64-bit Linux distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580 / Intel Arc A750 or better with Vulkan support
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio/PipeWire-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD and recent GPU drivers recommended. Recommended specs target smoother performance with advanced lighting, dense decoration, lava simulation, portals, and larger enemy swarms.
